operating_plan.cell_v_kind: Bench sweep including depletion. The nominal LBI threshold is about3.2V at the PowerBoost input, so cell voltage at shutdown is higher by the loaded path drop. This is not a guaranteed cell operating range or trip envelope.
operating_plan.basis: Initial bench configuration only. Verify 2% electrical brightness and the 2 W non-LED allowance before operation. No firmware ceiling or safe current limit is claimed; higher brightness needs another load review. Enclosed temperatures and current transients are unmeasured.

service.instruction: Support the assembly, put physical S1 fully OFF and disconnect USB, SWD and every other live interface before opening. The reviewed topology isolates the positive cell contact from all downstream stored-charge rails; it does not require a timed electronic reset for mechanical removal. Physical switch operation/insulation and all decay/reset times remain unmeasured. Insert one protected XTAR cell to the polarity marks, latch the door, select ON and press the on-only START button. A rapid swap may retain electronic state; do not promise a full reset or navigation/radio readiness from light output.
service.usb: Remove the cell, keep S1 OFF, use USB 5 V off-body. No barrel supply or other live interface at the same time. PowerBoost USB-A and battery JST are not installed; do not charge the cell in the pendant.
service.removal_basis: Ordinary OFF topology only, with no external power. All downstream module terminals are treated as conducting in the digital contact-isolation check. A failed switch, damaged insulation or an untested assembly is not physically qualified by this graph.

open_design_items.detail: Derive both installed wire cut lists and strain relief/envelopes from the new compartment/module layout. Current wire gauges alone do not complete routing.

startup_and_pulses.procedure: Measure boost input/output, battery current and radio/PWM/inrush on both assemblies across the declared cell range; no reset, trip or out-of-rating pin transient during normal use. Verify the320mA external3.3V allocation,2W average/3W peak non-LED planning budgets, logic-pin sequencing and radio duty cycle. With S1OFF and the cell removed, use only Sparkle USB; no powered BlackPillUSB or probe target supply. Measure actual PWM frequency, waveform/RMS current through each fuse and ripple through C_OUT; apply manufacturer continuous-current and temperature derating. The1.79A capacitor rating applies at100kHz/+105C and needs its frequency correction. Verify both capacitor-terminal peak voltage and current. Check Mode/Action contact behavior and measure the filtered PA4 startup/settling and unpowered-pin current. No ADC calibration or existing software timing is established by the nominal RC estimate.

latch_and_rebound.procedure: Measure BOOST.R20.2 and LATCH.OFF amplitude/duration. Low battery must switch B off; voltage rebound must not restart it. Repeat with bounce, slow depletion and a fast supply drop. Record power-loss defaults separately.

off_and_replacement.procedure: With S1 OFF and USB absent, verify both switch poles disconnect, all load/control rails decay and START has no effect. Measure decay before accepting any service dwell; repeat warm/rapid replacement. Repeat with F_FIB open: R_BOOST drains the isolated boost output, R_LOAD drains LOAD_5V, and R_OUT drains the isolated Fibonacci bulk capacitor.

short_and_reversal.procedure: Use controlled laboratory fault testing to verify reversal, overload/short interruption, cell PCM recovery and fuse/harness/contact withstand. Do not deliberately short an unprotected loose cell.

thermal.procedure: Measure cell, boost, latch, contacts, wires and front/rear touch temperatures in both closed enclosures at the stated ambient/load and wearing conditions, including warm recovery.

runtime.procedure: Measure usable energy and runtime at the named rainbow settings; compare with the model. No four-hour guarantee.

fit_and_worn_mass.procedure: Measure cell/holder contacts, retention/access and complete installed cell plus necklace mass. Digital geometry and estimated mass do not establish physical acceptance.

historical_recovery: electrical-review.md and the original electrical-*.json studies remain rejected custom-circuit evidence. Their counters/findings are not reset. They do not describe this module prototype.

signal_basis.allocation: design-v2.md, STM32 pin allocation; all3.3V logic. This is a wiring plan, not delivered new firmware or working navigation.
signal_basis.unused: No GPS backup coin cell. No external sensor power. BlackPill5V and USB remain disconnected. Program BlackPill through SWD with target power supplied by Sparkle; the probe does not supply target voltage.
signal_basis.gps_enable: GPS EN is a power-disable input: factory100kohm pull-down enables normal operation; drive PB7 high to disable. Preserve the pull-down; no new pull-up or firmware is added.
signal_basis.buttons: Preserve design-v2 ModePB13 and ActionPB14: active-low momentary contacts to commonGND, MCU pull-ups. Three direct PTS645SL70-2 actuators including START; no added firmware.
signal_basis.sense_filter: Retain100nF from PA4/divider midpoint to GND beside BlackPill, in addition to two100kohm resistors. Use a fixed insulated axial/radial assembly on a printed carrier; no custom PCB is implied. Assembly fit/settling/injection remain unmeasured.

supply_allocation.basis: Engineering allocations for bench verification, not guaranteed component maxima or measurements. Verify concurrent radio/PWM peaks and average current before accepting the prototype operating plan.
supply_allocation.duty_cycle: Review the all-peripheral peak concurrently; no radio duty-cycle reduction is used to approve the3.3V allocation. The2W average and3W peak are test targets, not a measured waveform.

fuse_basis.basis: Engineering selection using the adopted approximate20mA/channel and1mA idle NeoPixel model. A saturated rainbow has at most two active channels per pixel. At2% brightness the conservative coherent-PWM heating estimate is about1.31Arms for256 pixels, above the old1A fuse continuous allowance. Select2A Fibonacci and retain1A ring fuses. These approximate LED coefficients are not guaranteed silicon peaks; verify the real waveform and temperature before physical acceptance. Use axial251 fuses to avoid a custom SMD fuse carrier. Fuse nominal cold resistance and nominal melting I2t are not guaranteed fault or withstand bounds.
